title: A side-by-side with Claude Code desktop: the gaps said, and the small ones built
request: The owner asked for a side-by-side check of DCLab Code against the real Claude Code desktop app.
spec: docs/PARITY_EVIDENCE.md 'Side by side with Claude Code desktop'
plan: read what Claude Code desktop offers from this session's own capabilities (its app cannot be screen-captured from inside)
build the small ones: keep awake, transcript export, pinned and unread sessions

decisions.decision: compare by capability, not by screenshots
decisions.why: the Claude app is withheld from screen capture; this session's tools are its real feature list

decisions.decision: keep the Mac awake only while running or with a background job, not while waiting on the person
decisions.why: a question left open overnight should not keep the Mac up

decisions.decision: the server marks unread when a turn ends; the page clears it when the person looks
decisions.why: it survives a reload and works with the page closed

change: dclab-code server/awake.js and server/transcript.js (new), server/app.js (keep awake, export route, pinned and unread), server/engine.js (unread at a turn's end), web/* (Pinned group, unread mark, palette Export and Pin, keep-awake switch and status, own copy only for git projects), tests, docs/PARITY_EVIDENCE.md.

findings.defect: the parity table overclaimed: Claude Code desktop has features DCLab Code lacks
findings.scenario: split view, scheduled tasks, CI auto-fix, remote control, artifacts and more, found by the side-by-side
findings.cause: the first table listed only what DCLab Code had built
findings.fix: the gaps written in the evidence doc with their size; the small ones built

findings.defect: my first gap list said thinking was not shown
findings.scenario: the page already shows thinking as a folded Thought
findings.cause: a claim made before reading the page code

findings.defect: a new session in a non-git project could default to its own copy and fail on the first message
findings.scenario: another session busy in that folder: suggestWhere chose 'copy'
findings.cause: the suggestion did not check for git
findings.fix: 'Own copy' is disabled and never suggested outside a repository
findings.test: page test checks the option is disabled and 'here' chosen

findings.defect: a held caffeinate could keep the server process from exiting
findings.scenario: a test failed before close: the process hung
findings.cause: the child kept the event loop alive

outcome: DCLab Code keeps the Mac awake while agents work, exports transcripts, pins sessions and marks unread ones; the gaps it still has are written down by size.
lessons: A parity table written from what was built hides what was not: compare against the other product's own feature list.
Read the code before claiming a feature is missing.
risks: split view, scheduled tasks, CI auto-fix, side sessions, remote control, artifacts, simulator, computer use and connectors are not built
